_comment: Copy to the path config/project.json launcher.own_hosts_file names (config/own-hosts.local.json, git-ignored) and list fnmatch patterns for the hosts that are yours alone; scripts/launch.py lower-cases the host name and each pattern and drops a trailing dot before it matches.
